title: NRA successfully collected 100 billion SSP in the last two weeks – E-Service
publisher: Ministry of ICT and Postal Services, South Sudan
why: Q1: official ministry report that aerial mapping of Juba has commenced to support a digital land registry and postal service; does not state a live address register or national coverage.

title: Gov't to carry out aerial survey, base mapping in Juba
why: Q1: reports the ministry's digital mapping project to set up a Geographic Addressing System, Juba City and County as pilot, intended for mail, parcels, invoices, e-commerce and land (Q4 planned use).

title: Gov't announces aerial survey and base mapping initiative for Juba City
why: Q1: independent report that the mapping initiative is announced for Juba/Juba County, not yet a functioning nationwide service.

title: General Addressing Issues
why: Q2: UPU country list places South Sudan among countries that do not require postal codes.

title: City Council to rename streets within Juba
why: Q1: Juba City Council street and residential-area renaming exercise; local, predates the three-year window.

title: How South Sudan Got An Address
why: Q1: describes the lack of street addresses in Juba and ad-hoc addressing; context, not evidence of a live system.

title: How to Address an International Letter to South Sudan
why: Q3: secondary guidance that there is no formal postal-code system and street addressing is concentrated in Juba and major towns.
